# docsrs-cli

> One-shot stdin/stdout CLI for crates.io and docs.rs documentation for LLM agents.

docsrs-cli is a born-execute-finalize-die binary that searches crates on crates.io, fetches docs.rs README overviews and typed rustdoc items, searches in-crate symbol indexes, and validates local readiness with doctor. Stdout is the data contract. Stderr is diagnostics only. JSON is automatic when stdout is not a TTY.
